items_flat.title_en: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company for Codex and Git tooling
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將收購Pierre Computer Company以強化Codex與Git工具
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc., maker of Code Storage and open-source tools including Trees and Diffs already used in Codex. The deal aims to evolve Git workflows for parallel agentic coding, with open-source projects remaining open and Code Storage features eventually integrated into Codex.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布將收購Pierre Computer Company, Inc.，該公司開發Code Storage以及已用於Codex的Trees與Diffs等開源工具。交易旨在讓Git工作流程適應平行代理式編碼，開源專案將維持開源，Code Storage功能最終將整合進Codex。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands OpenAI’s control over the developer stack around Codex as agentic coding scales, potentially setting standards for source control that blend human decisions with agent output. Integration depth and any shift in open-source contribution pace remain to be seen after closing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉擴大OpenAI對Codex周邊開發者堆疊的控制，隨著代理式編碼規模擴大，可能為結合人類決策與代理輸出的原始碼控制設定標準。交易完成後的整合深度與開源貢獻節奏變化仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc. (“Pierre”), the company behind Code Storage and a family of standout open-source developer tools.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布OpenAI將收購Pierre Computer Company, Inc.（「Pierre」），該公司開發Code Storage以及一系列出色的開源開發者工具。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI autonomous pipeline finds and patches 948 Linux kernel LPE vulnerabilities
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI自主管道發現並修補948個Linux核心本地提權漏洞
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI detailed an autonomous vulnerability discovery, validation, and patching pipeline using an upcoming cyber model that identified 2,308 candidates in the Linux kernel, dynamically reproduced 1,724, and generated 948 working local privilege escalation exploits plus patches, at a total API cost of about $1.2 million.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI詳述一套使用即將推出的網路安全模型的自主漏洞發現、驗證與修補管道，在Linux核心中識別出2,308個候選項、動態重現1,724個，並產生948個可運作的本地提權利用與修補程式，總API成本約120萬美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The result shows frontier cyber models can systematically surface and exploit latent kernel bugs at scale far beyond manual efforts, raising both defensive capability and the urgency of automated patching. Real-world impact depends on how quickly maintainers can review and land the AI-generated fixes amid ongoing community hardening.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿網路安全模型能系統性地大規模揭露並利用潛在核心漏洞，遠超手動努力，同時提升防禦能力並凸顯自動化修補的急迫性。實際影響取決於維護者在社群持續強化下，能多快審查並採納AI產生的修補。
items_flat.quote: We've developed an autonomous vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and patching pipeline. In one run with our cyber model, it validated and generated patches for 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in Linux at an API cost of $1.2 million.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們開發了一套自主的漏洞發現、利用與修補管道。在使用我們的網路安全模型的一次運行中，它驗證並為Linux中的948個本地提權漏洞產生了修補，API成本為120萬美元。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for provable inference of model outputs
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開源FlashProve以可證明方式驗證模型輸出
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team released FlashProve, an open-source (Apache 2.0) prototype using zkSNARKs so developers can verify a response came from a specific model without revealing weights. On Llama 4 Maverick (400B MoE, 4-bit), a single proof verifies roughly 110 tokens per second on one H100.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic前沿紅隊釋出FlashProve，這是一個使用zkSNARK的開源（Apache 2.0）原型，讓開發者能驗證回應來自特定模型而不揭露權重。在Llama 4 Maverick（400B MoE、4-bit）上，單一證明在一張H100上每秒可驗證約110個token。
items_flat.analysis_en: This advances practical cryptographic verification of model identity, addressing trust issues in routing, evaluation, and potential substitution. It remains a research prototype with performance and adoption still constrained by proof generation overhead.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這推進了模型身分的實用密碼學驗證，解決路由、評估與可能替換中的信任問題。它仍是研究原型，效能與採用仍受證明生成開銷限制。
items_flat.quote: Today, we release FlashProve: an open-source performant prototype for provable inference. For a 400B-parameter mixture-of-experts model (Llama 4 Maverick, 4-bit quantization), we show that a single H100 GPU generates proofs at over 100 tokens/second...
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日我們釋出FlashProve：一個開源的高效可證明推論原型。對於400B參數的混合專家模型（Llama 4 Maverick，4-bit量化），我們展示單一H100 GPU以超過100 tokens/秒產生證明……

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral釋出1兆參數Large 4的開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk), a natively multimodal MoE model with ~1 trillion total / ~49-52 billion active parameters, on Hugging Face under a modified MIT license. Trained on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral在Hugging Face上以修改版MIT授權釋出Mistral Large 4（暱稱Le Chonk）的開源權重，這是一個原生多模態MoE模型，總參數約1兆、活躍參數約490-520億。使用3,800張Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPU訓練。
items_flat.analysis_en: This strengthens the open-weight frontier outside the US closed labs, offering a high-capacity European alternative for coding and multimodal work. Adoption will hinge on inference efficiency and community fine-tuning relative to larger closed models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這強化了美國封閉實驗室之外的開源權重前沿，為編碼與多模態工作提供高容量的歐洲替代方案。採用將取決於相對於較大封閉模型的推理效率與社群微調。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic uses Claude to map first 3D structure of a prokaryotic vault particle
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic用Claude繪製首個原核生物vault粒子的3D結構
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s biology research team reported the first cryo-EM structure of a vault-like particle assembled from a bacteriophage protein (L05), showing prokaryotic and phage MVP homologs can form vaults. Claude assisted literature search, isolation optimization (reducing purification from days to ~90 minutes), and structure determination (first model in 34 hours).
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic生物學研究團隊報告了由噬菌體蛋白（L05）組裝而成的vault狀粒子的首個冷凍電鏡結構，顯示原核生物與噬菌體的MVP同源蛋白也能形成vault。Claude協助文獻搜尋、分離優化（將純化從數天縮短至約90分鐘）以及結構測定（首個模型在34小時內完成）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This demonstrates AI accelerating a long-standing open problem in cell biology by compressing multi-week structural work into days under human direction, while still requiring expert oversight for errors. Functional insight remains limited; the result mainly expands the experimental system available for future study.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這顯示AI在人類指導下將數週的結構工作壓縮至數天，加速細胞生物學中長期未解的問題，但仍需專家監督以修正錯誤。功能洞見仍有限；結果主要是擴大未來研究可用的實驗系統。
items_flat.quote: We’re sharing another finding from Anthropic’s biology research lab: the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們分享Anthropic生物學研究實驗室的另一項發現：在原核細胞中發現的vault粒子的首個3D結構。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Daybreak Red (GPT-5.6 Cyber) available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Daybreak Red（GPT-5.6 Cyber）現已於AWS GovCloud（US-East）提供
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 Cyber via Daybreak Red is now available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock. It supports authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing with fewer restrictions for government and defense users.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布透過Daybreak Red提供的GPT-5.6 Cyber現已透過Amazon Bedrock向AWS GovCloud（US-East）的核准客戶開放。它支援授權的漏洞研究、利用驗證與安全測試，對政府與國防用戶限制較少。
items_flat.analysis_en: This extends specialized cyber capabilities into government-grade cloud environments, lowering barriers for public-sector defenders. Broader availability and real-world impact will depend on approval processes and integration with existing defense workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這將專門的網路安全能力延伸至政府級雲端環境，降低公部門防禦者的門檻。更廣泛的可用性與實際影響將取決於核准流程以及與現有國防工作流程的整合。
items_flat.quote: Building on the availability of Daybreak models on Amazon Bedrock, GPT‑5.6 Cyber is now available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Daybreak Red.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在Daybreak模型於Amazon Bedrock提供的基礎上，GPT‑5.6 Cyber現已透過Daybreak Red向核准客戶在AWS GovCloud（US-East）提供。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI任命Jill Hazelbaker為首席企業事務長
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI appointed Jill Hazelbaker, formerly President and Chief Corporate Affairs Officer at Uber (with prior roles at Snap and Google), as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer to lead global communications and corporate positioning. She will report to the CEO.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI任命曾任Uber總裁兼首席企業事務長（先前在Snap與Google任職）的Jill Hazelbaker為首席企業事務長，負責全球溝通與企業定位。她將向執行長報告。
items_flat.analysis_en: The hire signals OpenAI’s increased investment in external relations and reputation management as it scales. Effectiveness will depend on how the role navigates ongoing regulatory, safety, and competitive pressures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示OpenAI在規模擴大時增加對外部關係與聲譽管理的投資。成效將取決於該角色如何應對持續的監管、安全與競爭壓力。
items_flat.quote: Jill Hazelbaker will join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, leading the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.
items_flat.quote_zh: Jill Hazelbaker將加入OpenAI擔任首席企業事務長，領導公司的全球通訊與企業定位。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind adds agentic cheminformatics skills to Antigravity for drug discovery
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind為Antigravity加入代理式化學資訊技能以加速藥物發現
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity that combine language-model orchestration with deterministic tools (RDKit, ChEMBL, PubChem). In a lung-cancer example, an agent searched thousands of compounds, performed calculations, and proposed candidates in hours.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind為Google Antigravity釋出化學資訊技能，將語言模型編排與確定性工具（RDKit、ChEMBL、PubChem）結合。在肺癌範例中，代理搜尋數千化合物、執行計算並在數小時內提出候選者。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release shows agentic systems compressing multi-day medicinal chemistry loops into hours by delegating calculation to specialized tools while the model handles planning and reasoning. Broader adoption will depend on validation against experimental outcomes and integration into existing pharma workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此釋出顯示代理系統透過將計算委派給專門工具、而模型處理規劃與推理，將多日藥物化學循環壓縮至數小時。更廣泛採用將取決於對實驗結果的驗證以及與現有製藥工作流程的整合。
items_flat.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity, equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows. Using real-world lung cancer treatments, an agent searches through thousands of compounds... in just an hour.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在此我們展示配備新化學資訊學技能的Google Antigravity如何加速藥物發現工作流程。使用真實肺癌治療，代理搜尋數千種化合物……僅需約一小時。

google.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity that combine language-model orchestration with deterministic tools (RDKit, ChEMBL, PubChem). In a lung-cancer example, an agent searched thousands of compounds, performed calculations, and proposed candidates in hours.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind為Google Antigravity釋出化學資訊技能，將語言模型編排與確定性工具（RDKit、ChEMBL、PubChem）結合。在肺癌範例中，代理搜尋數千化合物、執行計算並在數小時內提出候選者。
google.analysis_en: The release shows agentic systems compressing multi-day medicinal chemistry loops into hours by delegating calculation to specialized tools while the model handles planning and reasoning. Broader adoption will depend on validation against experimental outcomes and integration into existing pharma workflows.
google.analysis_zh: 此釋出顯示代理系統透過將計算委派給專門工具、而模型處理規劃與推理，將多日藥物化學循環壓縮至數小時。更廣泛採用將取決於對實驗結果的驗證以及與現有製藥工作流程的整合。
google.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity, equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows. Using real-world lung cancer treatments, an agent searches through thousands of compounds... in just an hour.
google.quote_zh: 在此我們展示配備新化學資訊學技能的Google Antigravity如何加速藥物發現工作流程。使用真實肺癌治療，代理搜尋數千種化合物……僅需約一小時。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral釋出1兆參數Large 4的開源權重
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk), a natively multimodal MoE model with ~1 trillion total / ~49-52 billion active parameters, on Hugging Face under a modified MIT license. Trained on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral在Hugging Face上以修改版MIT授權釋出Mistral Large 4（暱稱Le Chonk）的開源權重，這是一個原生多模態MoE模型，總參數約1兆、活躍參數約490-520億。使用3,800張Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPU訓練。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This strengthens the open-weight frontier outside the US closed labs, offering a high-capacity European alternative for coding and multimodal work. Adoption will hinge on inference efficiency and community fine-tuning relative to larger closed models.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這強化了美國封閉實驗室之外的開源權重前沿，為編碼與多模態工作提供高容量的歐洲替代方案。採用將取決於相對於較大封閉模型的推理效率與社群微調。

brief_en: OpenAI acquired Pierre for Codex Git tooling and showed an autonomous cyber pipeline finding 948 Linux LPE exploits. Anthropic mapped the first prokaryotic vault structure with Claude and open-sourced FlashProve. Mistral released ~1T open-weight Large 4; Google added agentic cheminformatics to Antigravity. No major new model launches.
brief_zh: OpenAI收購Pierre強化Codex Git工具，並以自主管道發現948個Linux本地提權漏洞。Anthropic用Claude繪出首個原核生物vault結構並開源FlashProve。Mistral釋出約1兆開源權重Large 4；Google為Antigravity加入化學資訊代理技能。今日無重大新模型發布。
